# World kit

`game.world` reads and changes the world map: tiles and their climate, settlements and other world objects, caravans, world pawns, and the maps behind tiles. The kit is Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). `game.world.current` (older) returns the world handle.

Tiles are integers. World objects come back as `RimObject` values, which you pass to `object_info`, `remove_object` and `travel`.

```lua
-- Where is the nearest forest to settle in?
local tile = game.world.find_tile({ biome = "TemperateForest", max_distance = 60 })

-- All hostile settlements
for _, s in ipairs(game.world.settlements()) do
  if game.factions.is_hostile(s.faction, game.factions.player()) then print(s.name, s.tile) end
end
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.world.info` |  | `RimWorldInfo` | Size, seed and object counts of the world. |
| `game.world.tile_info` | `tile` | `RimTileInfo` | Biome, terrain, climate and what sits on a tile. |
| `game.world.distance` | `from, to` | `number` | Approximate distance in tiles between two tiles. |
| `game.world.settlements` | `faction?` | `RimWorldObjectInfo[]` | Settlements, optionally of one faction. |
| `game.world.objects` | `def?` | `RimWorldObjectInfo[]` | Every world object, optionally one def. |
| `game.world.create_object` | `def, tile, faction?` | `RimObject` | Places a world object on a tile. |
| `game.world.caravans` |  | `RimCaravanInfo[]` | Every caravan. |
| `game.world.pawns` | `opts?` | `RimPawn[]` | Living pawns that are not on a map. |
| `game.world.map_at` | `tile` | `RimMap?` | The loaded map on a tile. |
| `game.world.generate_map` | `tile, size?` | `RimMap` | Generates the map for a tile and returns it. Slow. |
| `game.world.biomes` |  | `RimBiomeInfo[]` | Every biome def. |
| `game.world.find_tile` | `opts?` | `integer?` | The nearest tile that matches the search. |
| `game.world.object_info` | `object` | `RimWorldObjectInfo` | Details of a world object. |
| `game.world.remove_object` | `object` | `boolean` | Removes a world object that has no loaded map. |
| `game.world.travel` | `object, tile` | `boolean` | Sends a caravan to a tile. |
